Based on VPAT® 2.5 Rev 508 edition (Section 508). Self-assessed, not third-party audited. Assessed by the Back End Developer bot for John Dilig from the repo's own checks.

  • Product: Ember UI, an accessible React design system starter (tokens, 8 components, Storybook docs). Storybook: https://jdilig.me/ux/design-system/storybook/ . Case study: https://jdilig.me/ux/design-system
  • Version: main at 757da0c (package ember-ui 0.2.2)
  • Report version: 1.0
  • Report date: 2026-11-10
  • Contact: https://github.com/balbonits/a11y-design-system/issues
  • Standards: Revised Section 508 (36 CFR 1194), which incorporates WCAG 2.0 A/AA (the 508 baseline). WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 A/AA criteria are extra rows, marked (2.1) or (2.2).
  • Scope: the components as rendered in the built Storybook. The Storybook docs site is a development tool and is not in scope of this report (its pages are still swept as test evidence below). An app that uses Ember UI is responsible for its own page structure (landmarks, H1, title, language).

Evaluation methods

  • **Automated (axe-core 4.x, npm run test:a11y):** every story and docs page in light and dark at 1024 px: 122 runs (50 stories + 11 docs pages x 2 themes), 0 serious or critical. The 288 moderate findings are all landmark-one-main, page-has-heading-one, region and landmark-unique. They come from rendering one component alone in an isolated Storybook story iframe, which has no page landmarks or H1, so they are findings about the test harness, not about the components.
  • Reduced motion (same script): the modal, toast and loading-button stories run 0 animations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
  • **Mobile (npm run test:mobile):** 11 docs pages x 320/375/414/768/920 px x light/dark = 110 runs, 0 failing (page overflow, 44 px targets, axe).
  • **Unit tests (npm test, Vitest + Testing Library):** 9 pass. They cover Modal focus in, Esc and close-button focus return (also when the app unmounts it), the Modal Tab trap, Tabs arrows/Home/End with wrap and disabled-skip, Toast roles, Toast auto-dismiss with hover pause, sticky action/error toasts, and the Undo action.
  • Keyboard: covered by the unit tests above and the per-component keyboard tables on each docs page. No separate manual keyboard pass is recorded yet.
  • Screen reader: not yet evaluated. Until a reader pass is recorded in PROGRESS.md (naming the reader, browser and OS), criteria that depend on announcements rest on markup, unit tests and axe only.
  • **Focus not obscured (node scripts/focus-obscured.mjs):** the Toast/Error story with 3 sticky toasts open and 60 full-width controls added behind them, Tabbed through at 320 and 1440 px in light and dark (240 focus stops). A stop fails if every on-screen sample point on it is under a toast. Result: 26 fully hidden, all at 320 px. Limit: the controls are full width, so a narrow control under the toasts at wide widths isn't covered by this check.
  • All runs: 2026-11-10 on main 757da0c (the focus check on feat/r8-conventions, whose component and story code is unchanged from 757da0c), Chrome (/usr/bin/google-chrome) via Playwright on Linux.

Terms

Supports, Partially Supports, Does Not Support, Not Applicable (as defined by VPAT 2.5).

WCAG 2.x Report (Section 508 Chapter 5, 501.1 and Chapter 6, 602.3)

WCAG 2.x Report (Section 508 Chapter 5, 501.1 and Chapter 6, 602.3)
CriteriaLevelConformanceRemarks
1.1.1 Non-text ContentASupportsIcon-only buttons need an aria-label (the Button type makes it required). Glyphs such as ✕ and the spinner are aria-hidden. Tested: axe.
1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)ANot Applicablemain has no media component. It becomes applicable when the VideoPlayer ships (Card 1-VP; captions, AD and transcript data in PR #8).
1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded)ANot ApplicableAs 1.2.1.
1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)ANot ApplicableAs 1.2.1.
1.2.4 Captions (Live)AANot ApplicableNo live media.
1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded)AANot ApplicableAs 1.2.1.
1.3.1 Info and RelationshipsASupportsField shell ties label, hint and error with for and aria-describedby. CheckboxGroup uses fieldset/legend. Table uses <caption> and scope="col"/scope="row". Tabs use tablist/tab/tabpanel. Tested: axe, unit tests.
1.3.2 Meaningful SequenceASupportsDOM order matches visual order. Tested: mobile sweep at 5 widths.
1.3.3 Sensory CharacteristicsASupportsNo component instructions rely on shape, color, position or sound. Tested: code review of the docs text.
1.3.4 Orientation (2.1)AASupportsNo orientation lock in CSS or code. Tested: code review.
1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose (2.1)AASupportsInput passes all native attributes through, including autoComplete, so apps set the purpose. Tested: code review.
1.4.1 Use of ColorASupportsErrors show a text message as well as a 2 px danger border. Toast tone is carried by role and title text, not only color. Tested: axe, code review.
1.4.2 Audio ControlANot ApplicableNo audio.
1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)AASupportsaxe color-contrast passes on every story and docs page, light and dark. The Tokens page computes live ratios for every documented pair. Tested: axe.
1.4.4 Resize TextAASupportsrem-based type scale and min-height controls. Tested: code review. No recorded 200% zoom run yet.
1.4.5 Images of TextAASupportsNo images of text.
1.4.10 Reflow (2.1)AASupportsNo page-level horizontal scroll at 320 px. Wide tables scroll inside a labelled, focusable region (allowed for data tables). Tested: mobile sweep.
1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (2.1)AASupportsControl borders, focus ring and checkbox use tokens at 3:1 or more. Tested: axe, Tokens page ratios.
1.4.12 Text Spacing (2.1)AASupportsNo fixed-height text containers; controls use min-height. Tested: code review. No automated text-spacing run yet.
1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus (2.1)AANot ApplicableNo content appears on hover or focus.
2.1.1 KeyboardASupportsNative buttons, inputs, select and dialog. Tabs follow the APG pattern (arrows, Home, End). Table scroll region and sort buttons are focusable. Tested: unit tests.
2.1.2 No Keyboard TrapASupportsModal keeps Tab inside while open by design. Esc closes it and focus returns to the opener. Tested: unit tests.
2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts (2.1)ANot ApplicableNo single-key shortcuts.
2.2.1 Timing AdjustableASupportsToasts with an action (such as Undo) and error toasts stay until dismissed. Info and success toasts auto-dismiss after 5 s, pause on hover or focus, and carry no required action. Tested: unit tests.
2.2.2 Pause, Stop, HideASupportsNothing moves for more than 5 s. The loading spinner shows only while an action is pending. Tested: reduced-motion check.
2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below ThresholdASupportsNothing flashes. Tested: code review of ember.css animations (one 200 ms pop).
2.4.1 Bypass BlocksANot ApplicableOwned by the consuming application; the Storybook docs site is a development tool and is not in scope of this report.
2.4.2 Page TitledANot ApplicableOwned by the consuming application; the Storybook docs site is a development tool and is not in scope of this report.
2.4.3 Focus OrderASupportsModal moves focus in on open and returns it on close. Tabs use a roving tabindex. Tested: unit tests.
2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)ANot ApplicableComponents don't render links.
2.4.5 Multiple WaysAANot ApplicableOwned by the consuming application; the Storybook docs site is a development tool and is not in scope of this report.
2.4.6 Headings and LabelsAASupportsModal requires a title (used as aria-labelledby). Fields require a label. Tested: axe.
2.4.7 Focus VisibleAASupportsA :focus-visible ring on every interactive element (src/ember.css). Tested: code review; axe doesn't measure focus rings.
2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (2.2)AAPartially SupportsOnly the toast viewport is fixed-position. Tested (scripts/focus-obscured.mjs): with 3 sticky toasts open over a page of 60 full-width controls, Tabbing through every control left 0 fully hidden at 1440 px, but at 320 px 26 of 120 focus stops (light and dark) were fully hidden behind the toast stack. The fix is tracked as card FU-FSD-TOAST.
2.5.1 Pointer Gestures (2.1)ASupportsNo multipoint or path gestures.
2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation (2.1)ASupportsNative click activation (up-event).
2.5.3 Label in Name (2.1)ASupportsAccessible names come from the visible label text. Tested: axe.
2.5.4 Motion Actuation (2.1)ANot ApplicableNo motion input.
2.5.7 Dragging Movements (2.2)AANot ApplicableNo dragging.
2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (2.2)AASupportsEvery control measures at least 44px (tested: mobile target scan); the --target-min CI gate is tracked separately.
3.1.1 Language of PageANot ApplicableOwned by the consuming application; the Storybook docs site is a development tool and is not in scope of this report.
3.1.2 Language of PartsAANot ApplicableNo other-language passages.
3.2.1 On FocusASupportsFocus causes no context change.
3.2.2 On InputASupportsSelect and Checkbox change only their own value. Tabs change the panel, which is the expected tab behavior.
3.2.3 Consistent NavigationAANot ApplicableOwned by the consuming application; the Storybook docs site is a development tool and is not in scope of this report.
3.2.4 Consistent IdentificationAASupportsThe same component gives the same name and role everywhere.
3.2.6 Consistent Help (2.2)ANot ApplicableNo help mechanism.
3.3.1 Error IdentificationASupportserror renders text tied by aria-describedby, plus aria-invalid. Tested: axe, stories.
3.3.2 Labels or InstructionsASupportsFields need a visible label. Required fields show a marker and set required.
3.3.3 Error SuggestionAASupportsThe error slot takes app-written help text; the stories show how-to-fix wording. The app owns the wording.
3.3.4 Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)AANot ApplicableComponents don't submit data. Toast action supports Undo for apps that need it.
3.3.7 Redundant Entry (2.2)ANot ApplicableNo multi-step processes.
3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum) (2.2)AANot ApplicableNo authentication.
4.1.1 ParsingASupportsWCAG 2.2 removes this criterion; React renders valid DOM.
4.1.2 Name, Role, ValueASupportsNative controls, aria-sort, aria-selected, aria-busy, aria-checked="mixed" for indeterminate. Tested: axe, unit tests. Not yet verified with a screen reader.
4.1.3 Status Messages (2.1)AAPartially SupportsToasts use role="status" (polite) and role="alert" for errors. Tested: unit tests. Partial until a screen-reader pass confirms the announcements.
